description: Gurķis LV — GitHub MCP server configuration example for Antigravity / Claude Desktop / VS Code. Copy this to your global mcp_config.json (e.g. ~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json) and replace <YOUR_GITHUB_TOKEN> with a GitHub Personal Access Token (PAT with repo / issues scope).

github.comment_windows: On Windows, command should use cmd.exe /c npx to avoid spawn ENOENT errors
github.comment_unix: On macOS / Linux, command can simply be 'npx' with args ['-y', '@modelcontextprotocol/server-github']
